summary: Wise Mountain lookout in Wise County, Virginia: a 1950 change of lookout is the only dated item found; the Forest Fire Lookout Association lists the tower as gone.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone; no source describes the site today

events.note: William E. Greear of Dungannon replaced Douglas Merle Dockery as lookout (Kingsport Times-News, as quoted by Forest Lookouts)

evidence.supports: Wise Mountain is in Wise County
date of the 1950 lookout replacement item

evidence.quote: March 19, 1950: Douglas Merle Dockery, at Wise Mountain lookout, has been replaced by William E. Greear of Dungannon. (Kingsport Times-News)

evidence.supports: Forest Fire Lookout Association lists the tower as gone

notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three. Forest Lookouts (one 1950 item) and the Forest Fire Lookout Association index (status and coordinates) are the only sources. The story is about 100 words, below the 120-word floor, because nothing else was found; the editor may prefer to hold it. Two web searches on Wise Mountain and one grep of the cached lookout lists and gazetteers found no construction date, height, design, fire history or fate. Search results surfaced High Knob and Buck Knob, which are separate towers and not used. Dungannon is a town, not a tower site.
